_nota: Nombre y línea en inglés de cada módulo para el contrato bilingüe (Anexo de módulos). Traducción de la primera frase de la descripción del catálogo. El formulario los precarga y se pueden editar.
assistant_ai: Operational chat per company to query modules, generate PDFs, read Excel files and execute actions with confirmation.
bots: Capture channels via Telegram, WhatsApp and automations.
campa_as_y_reportes_landing: Allows highlighting products, creating basic discounts and viewing sales, orders, most-viewed products and active campaigns.
carrito_y_pedidos___landing: The customer adds products, leaves their details and an order is created with a status: pending, confirmed, paid, shipped, delivered.
carta: Dish menu separate from inventory: direct or recipe-based dishes, cost per dish, margin and an alert when the price falls below cost.
clientes___crm___landing: Stores customers, WhatsApp, city, purchase history, interests and sales follow-up.
commercial_closing: Tracking of sales, closings and commercial results.
core: Operating base of the tenant, company, permissions and base services.
core_settings: Language, currency, password, preferences and general configuration.
costs: Costing by reference, production, service or order.
cotizacion: Prepares and executes quotes according to requirements and modules adapted to the company.
crm: Operational panel adaptable in real time according to the active modules.
day_closing: Daily operating summary by shift and active modules.
domicilios_whatsapp: The customer writes to the customer WhatsApp and receives a personal link to the menu; the order reaches the kitchen and the cashier as a delivery, with forwarding to the delivery person.
field: External teams, routes, evidence, tasks and field activity.
gps: Location, routes, perimeters and control of field teams.
hospitality: Bars, restaurants, tables, orders and customer service.
inventory: Stock levels, minimums, maximums and operating availability.
kpis: Dynamic executive indicators according to the active modules.
landing: ShopLink online store with catalog, categories, cart, checkout and web orders.
login: Allows logging in or recording clock-in, clock-out and breaks, within a mini panel or panel.
loyalty: Repeat customers, benefits and sales follow-up.
marketplace_access: Record of published listings with user, registered phone number, files and public link.
materials: Requests, approval, delivery, return and control of materials.
mini_panel: Allows creating a mini panel to grant users, roles and primary modules.
nomina_colombia: Automatic payroll under Colombian law: regular, night, Sunday, holiday and overtime hours from the shifts, transportation allowance, contributions and provisions, with parameters per year.
notas___agenda: Allows adding notes or keeping a calendar in a "Google" calendar style.
orders: Creation, tracking and status of orders.
pagos_y_comprobantes: Allows recording manual payments, uploading receipts and validating whether the order is paid or pending.
payroll: Calculation of hours, cutoffs, overtime, deductions and payments.
production: Times, references, productivity, closings and production costs.
productos_e_inventario___landing: Panel to upload products, photos, prices, sizes, colors, stock and status available/on the way/sold out.
qr: QR access for tables, operations or forms.
references: Catalog of references, products, sizes or measurable services.
registro_venta: Allows recording a sale as it happens.
retail: Stores, sales, requests and commercial inventory.
sales: Commercial activity, sales, conversion and results.
sanidad: Daily cleaning and logistics log for health inspections: items per company, signed closing, history and PDF.
shifts: Weekly shift schedule with rest and coverage rules by role, automatic scheduling, publication by bot and shift changes with candidates.
stock: Stock control, alerts, minimums and zero stock.
stores: Branches, points of sale and retail operation.
tables: Tables, tabs, sessions and QR operation.
transport_calls: Operating record of calls, assigned agent, duration, status and commercial result.
transport_contracts: Base of customers, contracts, guarantees, balances, consumption and alerts for transportation.
transport_payments: Treasury check, payments, invoicing and financial control of transportation tickets.
transport_quotes_tickets: Printable quotes, tickets and service orders with original and copy for transportation.
workforce: Employees, roles, statuses, availability and operating log.
